buyer_portal.description: An exceptional custom luxury home on 1.72 private, wooded acres. Custom 8′ double iron entry doors open to a grand foyer under a 23′ ceiling, with handblown chandeliers in the foyer, dining room and rear staircase and custom stained maple hardwood floors throughout the main level. Formal living and dining rooms sit off the foyer; the two-story family room carries custom molding and a fireplace, and the morning room a double-sided fireplace of its own. The gourmet kitchen is finished in Calcutta Gold marble with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, a large center island, butler’s pantry and breakfast room. A private home office and a mudroom with custom built-ins and lockers complete the level. Upstairs, the owner’s suite has a private sitting room, dual custom walk-in closets and a renovated spa bath with soaking tub and walk-in shower. The finished walkout lower level adds a large recreation room, wet bar, media room, two bedrooms, a full bath and storage, with new luxury vinyl plank flooring in 2026. Outside: an expansive deck, stone patio, outdoor kitchen, fire pit, a 9×10 hot tub and extensive professional hardscaping.
